rule: Preserve approved Home visual design; backend integration may change data, navigation and transaction states. CSS and branding changes require user approval.

navigation_change.changes: Mobile Home/Pools/Deals/Cart/Account; header Cart destination. No CSS, layout classes, footer contacts or branding changes. Account dashboard reuses the storefront header/footer with cross-page anchor links and Account-active mobile navigation; default Home appearance and search are unchanged.

mobile_header_repair.changes: One compact mobile logo/control row, short visible action labels with full accessible names, optional search in second row; shared fit across customer header variants. Approved desktop branding and storefront content preserved. Owner also requested removal of the duplicate header location and working notification access on all customer header variants.

mobile_dock_repair.changes: One shared Home/Pools/Deals/Cart/Account component in storefront, generic customer footer and AppShell; single locked geometry/contrast stylesheet; visible below 768px, fixed above the device safe area; scroll and native link UAT required. Footer contacts, brand and header design preserved.

tablet_branding.changes: Display full brand name and both official slogans from 768px upward across customer header families. Tablet storefront search moves below the brand/control row to retain space. Phone header and protected mobile dock unchanged.

customer_ui_unification.approved_by: User, 2026-10-14 all customer pages consistency request
customer_ui_unification.changes: Storefront header/footer are canonical for customer, My Money, auth, policy, product, community invite and unavailable-page states. Both permanent slogans appear in footer. My Money is available through the shared shopping menu and Account. Language preference is reused across chrome. Staff operations retain their existing frame and permissions. Phone/tablet branding and mobile dock guards remain required.
